description: Owned the code-ingestion engine for an AI context layer, rebuilding a scattered pipeline into clean, modular packages.
Built OAuth-based repo ingestion across GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket, plus an MCP server exposing search and retrieval over HTTP.
Cut ingestion cost by ~50% and retrieval latency by ~60% via token reduction and OpenRouter prompt caching.
Ran SWE-bench evals and a 14-model cost/quality comparison that set the model routing decision.
Building websites and full-stack apps for clients using Next.js, Vue.js and NestJS.
Designed dashboards, landing pages, and tools with clean UI/UX.
Scoped and delivered work directly with clients, from first call to shipped product.
Learning system design and automation with AI.
Developed [Router Nitro v2](https://routernitro.com/swap), improving cross-chain swap UX with a modular architecture that made new chain integrations faster.
Built the full [CEX withdrawal](https://x.com/routerprotocol/status/1904176702873633007) flow: 60+ users on day one, with direct bridging across 30+ chains.
Built Meme Duels, Router's real-time tap-trading game on Solana, end to end: React front end, Node.js game backend, Privy wallet auth. Shipped to beta.

Co-developed the [Tangled SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tangled3/react) for multichain integrations (EVM, Solana, Sui, Cosmos, Tron and more), and tuned the NestJS + PostgreSQL rewards backend for ~40% faster queries.
Created [Product](https://docs.thirdfi.org/product/overview) and [API Docs](https://thirdfi.readme.io/reference/introduction) with sample applications.
Wrote multiple [Getting Started](https://www.blog.thirdfi.org/) guides covering blockchain concepts and API usage.
Delivered Web3 workshops across several Discord communities, including LearnWeb3.
Contributed to the DerpDEX launch on zkSync and Base, and wrote its protocol, product, and getting-started docs on GitBook.
Published daily blogs on [Medium](https://medium.com/@0xblocktrain) and [Hashnode](https://blocktrain.hashnode.dev/).
Created educational videos on BlockTrain’s [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/c/Blocktrain).
Hosted blockchain meetups across Indian colleges.
Built demo projects for workshops and teaching sessions.
Grew engagement in PrepBytes’ coding challenges and workshops, including a contest with 700+ registrations.
Worked with student communities to help members improve their coding skills.
Organized API Hacks 2, a beginner hackathon focused on learning and building with APIs.
Ran participant workshops on Tech Phantom's YouTube channel.
